intuition: Packets arrive in timestamp order and leave in FIFO order, so each destination's active timestamps are also ordered.

brute_force.approach: Keep active packets in a list and scan it to count packets for each destination/time range.
brute_force.time: addPacket O(n), forwardPacket O(n), getCount O(n)

optimal.approach: Use a FIFO queue and duplicate set, plus per-destination sorted timestamp histories with a head offset for active packets.
optimal.time: addPacket O(1) amortized, forwardPacket O(1) amortized, getCount O(log n)
optimal.space: O(memoryLimit) active packets plus amortized compact histories

edge_cases: A duplicate is rejected before any capacity eviction.
A full router evicts its oldest packet before appending a valid new one.
